coverage_limits: Only the five approved PRE_TARGET_RECORD spans are used; the target court's reasoning and target-stage findings are withheld.
The approved spans contain competing allegations and denials but no supplied independent evidence or documented prior-court finding, so the evidence array is empty.
The supplied material does not establish whether DTTDC is the same person or entity as the Wine merchant or Wine Merchant mentioned in other spans; no identity relation is inferred.
The singular 'respondent' and plural 'respondents' are not explicitly reconciled by the approved spans and are therefore kept as separate entity records rather than silently merged.

The asserted permission of deceased landlord Sheikh Mohd. Yusuf is not stated in the approved span to have been in writing; no written-consent status or legal effect is inferred from that permission claim.

The phrase 'without paying of rent' does not identify the payer in the approved span, so the corresponding fact records only the stated absence of rent payment without assigning it to a particular entity.
Source wording such as 'wine and bear shop' and 'Wine or bear shop' is preserved without correcting or normalizing it.
